subject.title: fix: resolve response prefix template variables in abort replies

question: Should this stale conflicting PR be repaired in place, replaced by a narrower branch, or paused until the linked issue is reworked?
rationale: The bug is valid and the proof is useful, but the current branch has session-state correctness blockers and a conflicting base, so automation should not infer the intended merge path.

options.title: Repair before merge
options.body: Update the patch to carry active prefix context through routed abort delivery and active session/channel model state, then rebase and rerun focused proof.

options.title: Pause or replace
